reviews.text: Thank you, Tamara.

Stefanie is an incredibly wonderful dog trainer! She is very calm, patient, and listens carefully to what you need. She gives clear and practical advice and explains in a pleasant way what we are doing well and what we can still work on.

When we first met Stefanie, she had made a super nice goodie bag for Milo. That was a really lovely surprise for us! Very thoughtful and personal, and super tasty for Milo, of course. 🐶❤️

What I also really appreciate is that she comes to your location and really looks at the situation in practice. She helps where necessary and adapts her guidance to what you and your dog need. Your wish is her command! 😊

She tells us honestly and in a pleasant way what we as owners might not be doing right, but also what we are actually doing right. As a result, we are gaining more and more insight into how we can better understand and guide Milo.

Highly recommended for anyone who wants to work with their dog in a calm, committed, and professional manner! Thank you, Stefanie!

On recommendation, we enlisted Stefanie's help for our dog. Stefanie is a behavioral therapist with enormous expertise. She also provides a high level of aftercare. Everything is for the well-being of the dog and the owner(s). Furthermore, Stefanie is a very empathetic person. In short: highly recommended!

We had some fear based reactivity issues with Pam, our rescue puli but Stefanie helped us understand what we can do to help her be more confident and relaxed during the walks. We got all the necessary information during our consultation about what we need to improve and what Pam needs to learn (got clear step by step instructions for the new things we had to teach her). Stefanie is very helpful in the process and follow up period with our questions. She is super patient and supportive. Highly recommend her! I’m glad we found her and Pam is doing much better too.
Before Stefanie trained us how to make our dog less reactive, our little Taco used to bite a lot. With her advice she is much better now. Thank you!

Stef is a pup magician!

I adopted a rescue just over a month ago and worked with Stef to help me through those first few weeks.

As a first-time dog owner, Stef was incredible. She completely shifted my perspective, helping me think from my dog’s point of view and giving me amazing insights and practical steps for success. She guided me through her process of helping him understand that he’s now in his forever home.

But beyond her expertise, she was also an incredible support for me. She was available for my ten thousand questions at any time, sending hilarious videos to calm my frustration when things became a little harder and gently reminding me to be kind to myself. She doesn’t just provide heaps of expertise — she brings a HUGE heart to what she does.

Highly, highly recommend. Thank you for everything, Stef!
-- Ola x
Stefanie provided a very informative and useful customized training. I would definitely recommend her.

Stefanie has been incredibly helpful in helping us create the right awareness and understand what's best for our dog. By adjusting certain behaviors, he's more calm and less stressed. Her communication is very clear, we made solid agreements, we were given tools to work with, and she's also very dedicated. I would definitely recommend her. A true professional with a deep love for animals!
We needed help for our sweet four-legged friend, and we are so grateful that Stefanie helped us and continues to do so. Expertise and honesty in understandable language. Thank you, Stefanie!
Stefanie helped us tremendously during the first year with our Australian Shepherd, Winston. She provides clarity, direction, and confidence; she clearly knows her trade. Highly recommended!

Stefanie helped us very skillfully! Her advice and consultation felt right, and for the first time in a long time, it provided the language and approach our dog needed. We are experiencing more peace and joy with our dog! Thank you!

Super involved in Baco's efforts; we think Stef is a star for our dog.
You can always text him for questions etc. Definitely recommended.

I worked with Stefanie when my Jack Russell was still a puppy, and it completely transformed my experience. Before, I honestly thought getting a dog might have been a mistake, but after her guidance I feel confident, happy, and truly enjoy life with my dog — both inside and outside the house. Highly recommended!

We signed up with Woof-O because our Staffordshire Terrier, Tessa, was extremely insecure and didn't know how to interact with other dogs very well.

She lashed out, barked, and whined as soon as she saw other dogs.
Once Stefanie had visited, we received a very comprehensive "treatment plan" specifically tailored to Tessa.

We got to work with this, and now, a few weeks later, Tessa has made huge strides forward.
She no longer lashes out at other dogs, and she hardly barks or whines anymore.

We are so incredibly surprised by how quickly we are already seeing change; Tessa is much calmer and remarkably happier during walks!

And she has even played with another dog quite unexpectedly.

All in all, Woof-O is highly recommended!

And we are incredibly grateful to Stefanie for her help and dedication! ❤️

Stefanie went above and beyond when we booked her for training around our rescue dog's behavioural issues. She taught us so much about our dog's behaviour and helped us to understand his needs so much better. She was flexible, compassionate, and really helped us when things were difficult. I'd give her six stars if I could.

Stefanie is our first trainer and we would highly recommend her!

Fantastic experience with Stef and her services. Our dog is always super happy when Stef comes to pick her up in the morning and comes home cheerful after the walk as well. Every time, you receive nice videos and feedback on the walk that …
Had a super nice and useful training! Can recommend her to everyone :)
Amazing trainer with a lot of experience and giving great advice. Highly recommended.

Stephanie helped me and my Frenchies tribes big time!
Thanks to her useful tips and recommendations, my teenage pups are becoming more calm and friendly, which brings a lot of comfort to our household
